name: Nairu
source: Pathfinder #170: Spoken on the Song Wind

items.name: +1 Striking Composite Shortbow
items.description: This shortbow is made from horn, wood, and sinew laminated together to increase the power of its pull and the force of its projectile. Its compact size and power make it a favorite of mounted archers. Any time an ability is specifically restricted to a shortbow, it also applies to composite shortbows unless otherwise stated.

items.name: +1 Rapier
items.description: The rapier is a long and thin piercing blade with a basket hilt. It is prized among many as a dueling weapon.

items.name: Leather Armor
items.description: A mix of flexible and molded boiled leather, a suit of this type of armor provides some protection with maximum flexibility.

items.name: Arrows
items.description: These projectiles are the ammunition for bows. The shaft of an arrow is made of wood. It is stabilized in flight by fletching at one end and bears a metal head on the other.

items.name: Darkvision Elixir (Lesser)
items.description:
Activate Interact

After you drink this elixir, your sight becomes sharper in darkness. You gain darkvision for 10 minutes.

items.name: Giant Centipede Venom
items.description:
Giant centipede venom causes severe muscle stiffness.

Activate Interact (Injury)

Saving Throw DC 17 Fortitude

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 1d6 poison damage (1 round)

Stage 2 1d8 poison damage and Off-Guard (1 round)

Stage 3 1d12 poison damage, Clumsy 1, and off-guard (1 round)

items.name: Invisibility Potion
items.description: An invisibility potion is colorless and oddly lightweight. Upon drinking it, you gain the effects of a 2nd-rank invisibility spell.

generalAbilities.name: Swift Sneak
generalAbilities.description: Nairu can move their full speed when Sneaking.

defensiveAbilities.name: Deny Advantage
defensiveAbilities.description: Nairu isn't Off-Guard to creatures of 8th level or lower that are Hidden, Undetected, flanking or using Surprise Attack.

defensiveAbilities.name: Nimble Dodge
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger Nairu is targeted with a melee or ranged attack by an attacker they can see.

Effect Nairu gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.

offensiveAbilities.name: Poison Weapon
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements Nairu is wielding a piercing or slashing weapon and has a free hand.

Effect Nairu applied a poison to the weapon.

offensiveAbilities.name: Quick Draw
offensiveAbilities.description: Nairu Interacts to draw a weapon, then Strikes with that weapon.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sneak Attack
offensiveAbilities.description: Nairu deals an extra 2d6 precision damage to Off-Guard creatures.

offensiveAbilities.name: Surprise Attack
offensiveAbilities.description: On the first round of combat, creatures that haven't acted yet are Off-Guard to Nairu.

description:
Assassins commit murder, either for pay or due to their belief in a cause, such as a religion or a political movement. Some assassins work alone and choose their own victims. Others are members of assassins' guilds, organizations that accept contracts to kill in return for money, favors, or both.

Some criminals are the desperate who have no option but to break the law to survive, while others choose a life of crime for thrills, forming gangs or underworld guilds that specialize in certain illegal ventures.
